title: ci: add cosign login for chart signature push
body: ## Summary Fixes `UNAUTHORIZED` error when Cosign tries to push chart signatures to GHCR. The `cosign sign` command needs to push a signature artifact to the OCI registry, but only `helm registry login` was called — which authenticates Helm's own credential store, not Cosign's. Added an explicit `cosign login` step in both `ci.yaml` (RC chart signing) and `helm-publish.yaml` (release chart signing). ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Merge and verify that the next main push produces a signed chart without the `UNAUTHORIZED` error - [ ] Verify that the signature is visible in the GHCR package (cosign tree or cosign verify) ### Notes The same fix is applied to hriv in [#233](https://github.com/bcit-tlu/hriv/pull/233). Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c9c8c3ce533d4ff88d5015f0d9b32edb Requested by: @kphunter ---
